messages.author: 12f269733c6eb9a2
messages.subject: Re: Problems with DSM analysis - analysis halted due to missing
parts:
Philip:

From the subject line of your question, I think you are citing the
'same problem' as Ainars Aunins reported on 4 October last year. Please
have a look in the Distance sampling archive to see my answer to Ainars'
question

On 04/10/2011 14:10, Eric Rexstad wrote:
> > Ainars:
> >
> > I suspect you have not unticked the box that tells Distance to tidy up
> > after itself by removing old objects from the R workspace. Most times
> > being tidy is useful, but in this instance, the DSM engine needs the
> > objects created by the MRDS engine.
> >
> > Navigate to Tools | Preferences | Analysis and make sure the two
> > tickboxes underneath the Image properties button are not checked (see
> > screen capture at
> > http://www.creem.st-and.ac.uk/ericr/software/screenshot.4.png)
> >
> > I hope that will solve your problem.

Ainars reported that his problem was solved by ticking the appropriate boxes in the Analysis preferences. I hope that works for you as well.

Let us know if this solves your difficulties, or if you have a different
problem.
